result.title: Fast and Strong Image Protection against Diffusion Personalization
result.summary: Personalized text-to-image diffusion models can reproduce a person from a handful of photographs. Image protection perturbs each image before publication so that fine-tuning on it fails, but it optimizes every perturbation from scratch, so its cost grows with the number of images. We present the protective diffusion model (PDM), which is trained once and samples the perturbation of a new image over many denoising steps. PDM distills an iterative teacher and is then post-trained with the target residual projection (TRP) loss as a reward, a stronger objective than existing ones. PDM outperforms nine baselines on faces and artworks and nearly matches its teacher at a tenth of the cost.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一次训练、可对新图像采样保护扰动的扩散模型 PDM，用于阻断基于少量照片的个性化微调，并以蒸馏加奖励后训练降低逐图优化成本。
